status.current: actively gathering material for a postwar Hagun wall-newspaper special

relationships.nagi-arisuin: Walks with him through the celebration while reporting.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Asks to interview her about the Vermillion war and Japan battle.
relationships.kurono-shinguji: Wants to interview her after she wakes because Kurono is the greatest hero of the Tokyo defense.

periods.summary: Kagami turns the Tokyo victory celebration into a reporting opportunity. Using Raise Up to multiply herself, she interviews soldiers, students, civilians and children across the city, planning a large summer special for the Hagun wall newspaper. She comforts Stella over the Vermillion crisis and asks to hear the story once Stella finds Ikki, showing both journalistic curiosity and personal concern.

key_events.summary: Reports across the celebration and reunites with Stella, Shizuku and Alice.
